take: ideaForge faces heavy revenue lumpiness and a severe working capital drag, with the cash conversion cycle stretching to 587 days. Despite high order book figures, persistent cash burn (-INR 63 crores CFO in FY26) exposes execution risks.

promises.promise: Blended EBITDA margin expectation for the year is 50% to 55%
Blended gross margin would likely hover between 50%, 55% for the year
Complete delivery of remaining order book of INR256.8 crores by Q3
Deliver 40% to 45% of the open order book in Q4 FY26
promises.delivered: Executed around 40% of open order book, recording INR141.04 crore revenue

promises.promise: Gross margin trajectory of 50% plus for FY26
promises.delivered: Full year FY26 revenue was INR226 crores with OPM at 2.6%

narrative.claim: Management stated that the open order book of about INR310 crores is slated for execution in FY27.
narrative.numbers: Revenue for Q1 FY27 was recorded at INR68.59 crores.

narrative.claim: Management highlights strong operational profitability and positive EBITDA at the close of FY26.
narrative.numbers: FY26 annual PAT was negative at -INR17 crores with negative operating cash flow of -INR63 crores.

bull.point: Opening order book stands strong at INR 3,140 million for FY 2026-27, supporting medium-term revenue visibility.
Demonstrated capability to scale execution sharply during favorable quarters, hitting INR 141.04 crores in Q4 FY26.
Extensive R&D footprint with over 300 members across four product development centers supporting technological moats.

bear.point: Working capital conditions have deteriorated significantly, with the cash conversion cycle stretching out to 587 days.
Continuous cash burn with negative operating cash flows of -INR 63 crores in FY26 against a net loss of -INR 17 crores.
High revenue lumpiness across quarters, driven by dependent government procurement cycles and defense ordering schedules.

watch: Execution progress against the remaining order book by Q3 FY27
Debtor days and cash conversion cycle improvements
Realization of guided 50-55% gross and EBITDA margins
